name: sparkline
description: Sparkline — a code-based real-time communication platform

scripts.setup: cd server && npm install --no-bin-links && cd ../client && npm install --no-bin-links
scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
